connection_condition: Team.team_api_id and Team.team_fifa_api_id identify the same team row; Team_Attributes carries both columns, while Match carries only team_api_id
description: The internal and the FIFA team identifier are alternative identifiers of the same team. Questions that ask for a team's FIFA identifier must read team_fifa_api_id even when the filter comes from a table that only carries team_api_id.
A team is composed of its dated playing-style profiles; a playing-style profile has no meaning without the team it describes.
A player is composed of their dated ability profiles; an ability profile has no meaning without the player it describes.

connection_condition: Team_Attributes.date is one of the identifying columns of the profile row
description: Each team playing-style profile is identified by its team together with its snapshot date, so the date is a required component of the profile identity rather than a free attribute.

connection_condition: Player_Attributes.date is one of the identifying columns of the profile row
description: Each player ability profile is identified by its player together with its snapshot date, so the date is a required component of the profile identity rather than a free attribute.

connection_condition: Match.season groups the fixtures belonging to that season
description: A season is composed of the matches played in it; every match carries exactly one season label.
A league is composed of the matches played in it; a match cannot exist without the league that staged it.
A country is composed of the leagues staged in it; each league belongs to exactly one country.
The birth year is derived from the calendar year part of the birthday value, which is what cohort statements such as being born before a given year or after a given decade compare.
Total match goals include the home team's goals.
Total match goals include the away team's goals.

connection_condition: compared against Match.home_team_goal of the same match
description: An away win is derived by comparing the away team's goals with the home team's goals in the same match; the away team wins only when its goal count is strictly greater.
The number of matches for a league or season is derived by counting the qualifying match records.
The speed class label is derived by banding the numeric build-up play speed of the same profile row into Slow, Balanced and Fast.

connection_condition: the class column bands the numeric chance-creation passing rating of the same profile row
description: The chance-creation passing class is a categorical banding of the numeric chance-creation passing rating into Safe, Normal and Risky.
Attacking work rate is a use of the shared work-rate scale, and its valid value domain is the subset low, medium and high of the work-rate levels.
Defensive work rate is a use of the shared work-rate scale, and its valid value domain is the subset low, medium and high of the work-rate levels.

connection_condition: indirect: only through the home_player_1..11 and away_player_1..11 slots of Match, which hold player_api_id values
description: Players and teams are related through match participation; no identifier links a player directly to a team, because squad membership is recorded only as player slots on match records.

connection_condition: Match.home_team_api_id and Match.away_team_api_id correspond to Team.team_api_id
description: A match is played by a home team and an away team; the two sides are roles that a team takes in a match rather than components of it.
